sloka: इन्द्रजित्तु रथे स्थाप्य सीतां मायामयीं ततः।बलेन महता ऽ ऽवृत्य तस्या वधमरोचयत् ।। ६.८१.५ ।।
transliteration: indrajittu rathe sthāpya sītāṁ māyāmayīṁ tataḥ।balena mahatā ' 'vṛtya tasyā vadhamarocayat ।। 6.81.5 ।।

translations.english: Indrajith, also through a trick, wanted to make illusory Sita and place her in the chariot surrounded by Rakshasas and thought of killing her.
